final: WITH site_sums AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) as site_sum FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(site_sum) as total_val FROM site_sums), fractions AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.site_sum, CAST(s.site_sum AS FLOAT) / t.total_val as frac FROM site_sums s, totals t WHERE t.total_val IS NOT NULL), avg_frac AS (SELECT AVG(frac) as avg_val FROM fractions) SELECT s.zoneref, s.site_sum, s.frac, s.frac - a.avg_val as diff FROM fractions s, avg_frac a WHERE a.avg_val IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.frac - a.avg_val IS NOT NULL DESC, s.frac - a.avg_val DESC LIMIT 10
